axes.concept: Spatial workbench: the existing Taller scene sits directly over its table inspector, with the original catalogue and tool rail at the left.
axes.layout: Desktop 60px tool rail + 312px catalogue + canvas-over-inspector workspace; two fieldsets under the canvas. On phone the scene precedes one switchable working sheet.
axes.navigation: Existing Paneles rail stays in place. Native Grupo selector browses catalogue groups; Mesa y lista buttons switch the dock; Añadir/Pieza/Lista de compra switch the phone sheet. Export remains in the header and the shopping list remains a dialog.
axes.typography: Existing embedded Geist Sans, 24px catalogue title, 20px dock headings, 14px controls and Geist Mono dimensions/quantities. No new font family.
axes.density: Two-column illustrated catalogue, two-column desktop inspector, three compact numeric measures together. Flat scene and divided dock; existing 10/12px controls/cards and rounded sibling account disclosure.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input, Skeleton and Animate UI Dialog. Custom SVG scene illustration and catalogue miniatures, native selects/details, and the product table perimeter/default data.
axes.colour: Unchanged Pictures and Taller tokens from globals.css; shared accessible primary/input mappings from cuentas-admin. Neutral group navigation; purple only on existing primary controls and focus. Scene material colours come from the existing furniture data.
axes.motion: Spatial settling: catalogue enters from left, canvas from right, dock unfolds upward, cards stagger 35ms with a slight rotation, table lands, chairs settle sequentially, feedback folds in, export panel opens from its header anchor. Expressive 620ms, controls 180ms; cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1) and production ease-out. Reduced motion removes travel, hidden tabs and offscreen export progress pause.
